title: calluna vulgaris subf. searlei
intro: Calluna vulgaris subf. searlei, commonly known as heather, is a subspecies of the Calluna vulgaris plant, native to the northern hemisphere. It is a low-growing, evergreen shrub with medicinal properties. The health benefits of Calluna vulgaris subf. searlei include its potential to reduce inflammation and improve cardiovascular health, while its therapeutic actions include antioxidant and anti-inflammatory effects. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and volatile oils, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
